reviews.text: Why send an email to regular customers informing them that they're suddenly closed in the afternoons for a whole week because they're worth it? My cat suddenly became seriously ill, and I rushed to them only to find this unpleasant surprise. If you had any professionalism, you would have sent an email informing me that you wouldn't be open in the afternoons this week! This would have prevented me from encountering this situation. But it seems that's just how things are here. I guess I'll have to find another vet, and I hope my cat doesn't get worse because I wasted my time going to your place, since you didn't even send a simple answering machine message informing me that you were closed.

I take my two cats to this vet and they've always been very professional and attentive, always taking the necessary time for each appointment. I'm very happy with the way they treat me and my furry friends.
Very friendly and super professional treatment. I recommend the center 100%
Excellent service. Always very willing to take care of my dog ​​Rocco 🐶. …

I was planning to make my cat's first appointment, and today I went to buy external parasite treatment. The staff were so unenthusiastic, gave me such a sour look when I asked about what I was buying, and it was so unpleasant... that when I got home I had to ask the vet about the pills. I don't know much about veterinary care, but thanks to their lack of enthusiasm and focus on making a sale, they lost four customers (my pets).

They don't deserve any stars.
After many years of taking care of our dog, today when we need to go to the emergency room they don't want to take care of us because, they argue, we don't have an appointment. Not only that, but they say they'll close soon, even though the website says a different time.
Lack of sensitivity towards the patient, and lack of respect towards the customer.
I'm sorry, but we won't see you again. You don't love animals.

Excellent! We've been bringing our dogs and cats to the Veteros clinic for years. The service has always been great. Our doctors were Jesus and Yolanda, both very nice and professional. A big plus of this clinic is that they don't try to extort money from clients by requesting unnecessary tests or keeping the animal overnight for examinations. Unfortunately, we had a similar experience at another clinic, where our ferret had to suffer unnecessary for two months, not even mentioning the bills for that
Good attention. Very kind and concerned about the animal. Yolanda is a 10. Loving, empathetic

Yolanda has been taking care of my four cats since I got them. She was there for me when I lost one of them, and I'm truly grateful. She's been incredibly patient with someone as anxious as me, who worries at the slightest thing about her cats. She's the best, in my opinion, and I'm so thankful for all the work and effort she puts in, even these past few months when she hasn't had a partner and has managed everything on her own. She's not only a fantastic veterinarian but also a wonderful person.

Came to get my dogs worming treatment to enter England and the vet administered the wrong medication and we got refused on the Eurotunnel.
As it was a Saturday night had to wait until Monday to go to another vets and then go to England the following day. Her mistake cost me €600 on hotels, taxis, and another pet transfer ticket to cross the channel with Le Pet Express. Not to mention also 4 days wasted stranded in Calais and missing my mums birthday which is the reason we were traveling back. Unforgivable.

My favorite Veteros center, with Yolanda who is an excellent professional, approachable, kind... the best, something we should never lose: professionalism and the best personal treatment and care for our best companions.
Dr. Yolanda is an angel sent from heaven. Thank you, thank you, thank you. Greetings from Mexico, and our deepest gratitude for all your care for Rita Pug.

For many, many years, my mother has always taken her animals there, and so have I. Whenever there's been a problem with an animal, they've always found the cause and the cure. It's my trusted place. I'm grateful for the staff, some of whom are still there after all these years. I recommend it 100%.
Such a wonderful veterinary clinic. The staff is highly skilled, speaks English and takes well care of the customers and their lovely furry friends .!
My trusted veterinarian.
We chose this clinic because of the reviews and its proximity for our cat Nami. So far, we're happy with all the care she's received.
Great! The care provided by veterinarians Yolanda and Jesús is impeccable, professional and always kind and attentive to the needs of your animal. Soraya's kindness is also worth highlighting.

If you're in the area and want to help your pet, I recommend the Montjuic Veterinary Hospital. I first went to Veteros for an emergency, and they had to refer me to another vet. They had no idea what was wrong with my dog; I took her there because I didn't know what was wrong, and neither did they. I got a diagnosis at the Montjuic Veterinary Hospital. Don't waste your time or money at this other place.

At Veteros they referred our dog, Quima, to the Montjuïc Veterinary Hospital given the seriousness of the case, I can understand that perfectly and the treatment at the veterinary hospital was very good and very humane until her death. I find it hard to understand that at Veteros after caring for her for fourteen years they didn't have the detail to ask if she was alive or dead (she died two months later than they thought).
Excellent service, super professional
Trustworthy veterinarians, kind and caring towards our pets.
